name: placed
says: ADDENDUM (plan 79.48): what a side strikes is the base document's `attacked` in every game, atomic included (the trait says: whether some unit of the owner bears on the place). This document only ADDS a second, separately named relation for the other meaning atomic has: a place is struck for the purpose of check when the description's `struck` says so (it leaves out a place beside the striker's own leader). It is not the definition of strikes_place; the difference between the two is a known difference of meanings, held as a state in translated_placed_known.rs.

questions.says: the places a side strikes in the sense of the description's `struck` (the check notion); answers no method of the trait
